summary: The root نبع (nbE) primarily refers to a specific tree, known for its strong wood. This wood was commonly used for making shafts, such as those for carts, leading to the term نبعان for the two shafts.
lane: نَبْعٌ ذ The tree so-called: see an ex. of its n. un. in a verse cited voce تَحَوَّفَ and تَخَوَّفَ . -b2- نَبْعٌ : see شَوْحَطٌ and شِرْيَانٌ and فَتْحٌ . -b3- نَبْعَانِ The two shafts of a cart: so called because they were commonly made of wood of the tree called نَبْع : see رَادَّةٌ .
